Hi Vanessa,

Quick one as we lock the numbers for our Q1 spend: we expect to renew our Dedicated plan on 2027-01-15 and want to add two additional GPU nodes (estimate attached). Finance asked for our Redwood billing contact to be "Redwood Billing Team" and requested a PO to be issued to Redwood Inference for the renewal + add-on.

Could you confirm the exact billing name and address you need on the PO, whether Net30 is acceptable, and where we should send the signed PO and tax form (W-9)? Our procurement prefers a single PDF with PO + W-9 attached.

Thanks — I attached a draft internal PO and the vendor request so you can see the fields they need filled.

Hi Laura — thanks for the heads up. Happy to coordinate. Quick answers:

- Billing name/address for PO: Redwood Inference, Inc. / 410 Townsend St, San Francisco, CA 94107 / Tax ID: 82-1234567
- Payment terms: Our default enterprise terms are Net30 for SaaS services; for Dedicated reserved capacity we can agree Net45 for this contract if procurement needs it, but that requires an amendment to the order form.
- Send signed PO + W-9 to finance@redwood.ai (PDF preferred). If they want an invoice copy routed directly, cc marcus_lin@redwood.ai.

To speed this along I copied Marcus (Finance) and Monica (Customer Success — contract side). Marcus: can we accept the PO as-is with Net30 or do we need a formal amendment for Net45 and if so what is the internal approval ETA?

Laura — if procurement can indicate the desired net term in the PO, we can route the request appropriately and return a countersigned DocuSign within 2 business days if no Net45 amendment is required.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz

Hi all — finance reviewed the attached PO and W-9. We can accept Net45 for this renewal but we do need a one-page amendment to the master order stating the payment term change from Net30 to Net45 for the 2027 term. That amendment is administrative only and does not change pricing or capacity; I will open the amendment now and send a DocuSign link.

Process timeline:
- I will create and send the one-page Net45 amendment via DocuSign by end of day today.
- Once countersigned, Redwood will issue the invoice on 2027-01-15 and our AP team will reference PO NIM-PO-7892 for reconciliation.
- Monica will attach the amended order to the customer record and note the capacity add in the renewal summary.

Laura: please confirm the correct signatory for the amendment (Name & Title) so we can populate DocuSign fields. If you want the amendment returned as a PDF first for internal review, let me know and I'll send a PDF draft rather than live DocuSign.

Thanks — Marcus
